Marketing footer set on an architectural cutting-mat grid with multi-column navigation links and copyright bar.

Sticky marketing navigation bar with Framerock brand lockup, section links, GitHub link, and keyboard-accessible sign-in button.

First-run onboarding card with animated API key reveal, copyable AI SDK setup prompt, and documentation link.
Top-level observability overview dashboard combining KPI stat cards, latency/token/error trend charts, and cost attribution tables.
Full-viewport codebase scan explorer pairing the floating architecture summary sidebar with the interactive flow map.
Interactive codebase scan landing hero with copyable CLI command and embedded architecture flow map preview.
Multi-turn session transcript inspector displaying user messages, assistant responses, tool calls, and per-turn token/cost metrics.
Interactive instrumentation plan review board combining detected agent/workflow decisions with live flow-map spotlighting.
Trace execution waterfall inspector with span timeline, token/cost percentiles, evaluation score pills, and payload drawer.
Filterable, sortable, and paginated traces table with agent, workflow, model, customer, and error-status filters.
Workflow execution dashboard displaying run volume, error rate, duration percentiles, and expandable multi-trace run trees.

Disclosure group for showing related trace, run, or evaluation details. The root supports multiple expanded items, as used by the shipped story.
Modal confirmation flow with a backdrop, title, description, and action or cancel controls. Content size and cancel button styling are exposed by this wrapper.
Compact status or warning container with separate title, description, and action slots. The wrapper offers default and destructive treatments.
Container that keeps its content at a numeric width-to-height ratio. The ratio is required and passed to the underlying div wrapper.
Identity image with a fallback, optional badge, and grouped-avatar layout. The root accepts sizes default, sm, lg, and xs.
Compact status label with default, semantic color, and outline treatments. Variant and size values come from the exported variant recipe.
Navigation trail built from a nav, ordered list, items, links, current-page label, separator, and overflow marker.
Grouped control row or column with optional text and separator slots. Its orientation variant changes the group layout.
Action control with seven visual variants and eight sizes. It preserves Base UI button polymorphism through the render prop and infers native-button behavior when render is absent.
DayPicker calendar with Framerock button styling, chevrons, and range selection states.
Content container composed from header, title, description, action, body, and footer slots. The root offers default and compact sizes.
Embla-backed, axis-aware carousel with content, item, previous, and next controls. The root accepts Embla options and plugins and can expose its API through setApi.
Chart container, tooltip, and legend helpers for Recharts. ChartConfig maps series keys to labels and optional color or icon metadata.
Base UI checkbox root with project input-control styling and forwarded checkbox state and accessibility props.
Controlled or uncontrolled disclosure root with separate trigger and panel exports.
Searchable selection control with list, group, empty, chip, clear, and separator parts. The input can show a trigger or clear button.
Command menu composition built on cmdk, with an optional dialog wrapper, search input, groups, options, empty state, and shortcut label.
Right-click menu with nested submenus, checkbox and radio items, labels, separators, and shortcut text.
Modal dialog built from Base UI root, backdrop, popup, title, description, and close parts. The popup shows its close button by default.
Direction provider and hook used to set or read left-to-right and right-to-left layout context.
Modal drawer composition with trigger, portal, backdrop, content, heading, and footer parts, backed by the project drawer primitive.
Positioned menu with groups, nested submenus, checkbox and radio items, labels, separators, and keyboard shortcut text.
Structured empty state with header, media, title, description, and content slots. Media supports default and icon variants.
Form-field composition with fieldset, legend, label, description, error, separator, and layout slots. Field orientation supports vertical, horizontal, and responsive layouts.
Preview card opened by a trigger. Its content wrapper exposes popup placement options from Base UI.
Input or textarea composition with aligned addons, buttons, and text. Addon alignment and button size and variant are configurable.
OTP input composition with groups, indexed slots, and separators. The root adds a class for the OTP input package container.
Styled native input that keeps standard input attributes and forwards its input type and other native props.
General-purpose row composition with media, content, actions, header, footer, and separator slots. The root and media slots expose independent variants.
Keyboard-key label and group wrapper for displaying one key or a sequence of keys.
Styled native label that forwards standard label attributes.
Text shimmer indicator with a configurable message, size, and class name.
Horizontal Base UI menubar composed with menu, trigger, popup, item, submenu, radio, checkbox, separator, and shortcut parts.
Styled native select with option and option-group exports. The select supports default and compact sizes.
Site-navigation menu with list, item, trigger, content, positioner, link, and indicator parts. Its link wrapper closes the menu on click by default.
Navigation landmark with page list, active link, previous and next controls, and an ellipsis marker.
Non-modal floating panel with trigger, content, header, title, and description parts. Content exposes Base UI positioner alignment and side options.
Progress root with track, indicator, label, and value slots, backed by Base UI progress state.
Radio-group container and radio item, backed by Base UI state and keyboard behavior.
Panel group, panel, and resize handle composition backed by react-resizable-panels. The handle can add its visual grip.
Scroll container and scrollbar pair backed by Base UI. The scrollbar defaults to vertical orientation.
Base UI selection control with popup positioning and scroll controls. When items is omitted, the root collects labels from nested SelectItem children.
Semantic horizontal or vertical divider backed by Base UI separator.
Dialog-based side panel with configurable edge, default or floating treatment, and optional close button.
Collapsible navigation layout with provider state, side and layout variants, menu rows, actions, badges, skeletons, and a useSidebar state hook.
Styled placeholder block for content that has not loaded yet.
Base UI slider with a numeric range and controlled or default values.
Toaster adapter that forwards Sonner ToasterProps and keeps the project theme and visual treatment.
Inline SVG spinner that forwards SVG attributes.
Base UI switch with default and compact sizes and root state props.
Semantic table composition with optional internal scrolling and sticky headers. Rows can opt into keyboard-accessible interaction, and cells accept start, center, or end alignment.
Base UI tabs composition with root orientation and default or line list variants.
Styled native textarea that forwards standard textarea attributes.
Base UI toggle group with shared variant and size choices, explicit orientation, and configurable spacing between items.
Base UI toggle with default or outline treatment and default, small, or large size.
Base UI tooltip root, trigger, popup, and provider. Popup placement is configurable, and provider delay defaults to zero milliseconds.

Renders a model-provider icon from its model name.

Renders a page title, supporting copy, and optional back navigation.
Reports the visible row interval and exposes page changes.
Renders structured payload data as JSON, prose, message parts, and tool calls.

Parses and renders a prompt template with slot examples and token estimates.
Links to the prompt-version view for an agent.
Compares prompt versions, their templates, and slot values.
Displays span quota usage and its current percentage.
Renders the shared reporting range controls and preset choices.
Provides shared range state and the setter returned by useRange.
Formats a timestamp as relative time.
Renders the conversation and tool exchange for a run.
Exports the scan mark, favicon, and model icon used by scan screens.
Provides a controlled search field for table filtering.
Renders a table header that reports the current sort direction and handles sort changes.
Maps span type names to their icon, color, and badge treatment.
Composes a statistic label and value with optional delta, chart, and meter details.
Renders a compact label and value pair.
Shows the service sunset notice and its fixed shutdown date.
Provides the light, dark, and system theme choices.
Renders a controlled active/inactive filter chip.
Groups tool usage rows and their costs for the supplied range data.
Maps a tool name to its icon, with a fallback for unknown names.
Arranges table controls and trailing summary content.
Renders trace spans on a timed waterfall and reports the selected span.
Exports the selectable chart legend and range-bucket helpers used by trend views.
Renders a user menu from an explicit session and sign-out callback.
